title.title: The Correspondence of Esther Roberts Hunt Collins

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of Quaker minister Esther Roberts Hunt Collins is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

div.p: I have been longing for a letter from thee, & last evening received one, dated 24th 1st mo 1794 which was indeed acceptable, & take it kind thy sending me the accounts it contained, which is affecting. & O, may the inhabitants of the Earth learn righteousness from this sore judgment, that heavier chastisement may not be needful, saith my soul.

Thee has been pleased to mention something respecting thy provings, which I hope may be of some use, for we are apt to think our trials harder or different from others. But he that beholds the secret of every heart knows what food is most convenient for us, & it is the desire of my heart that we may indeed know such an establishment that heights nor depths, things present or to come, may never be able to divert our minds from the true object, or weaken our faith in Christ Jesus.

O, my dear Brother, my tongue nor pen cannot express in an intelligent manner our situation as it appears to me, in a religious sense. But think it may be truly said the ways of Zion do mourn, because there are so few that come to her solemn feasts; so few that are fully given up to be, what the Lord would have us to be. There's something spared & kept alive which ought to be slain; that obedience has not kept pace with knowledge.
And at times, our situation appears so low & discouraging that, except the Lord should be pleased in in riches of his Mercy, to raise up some to stand for the cause of truth. We shall become a reproach, that over the daughters of the uncircumcised will rejoice over us.

We appeared in a suffering way respecting the neglecting of the due attendance of meetings & there has been a little movement made in visiting some of them, Rebecca Dixon & myself, joining men Friends therein last week, which afforded some encouragement. But, the labor appears too great for the labors, many that ought to be useful, have not kept themselves unspotted from the world, that their service is laid waste.

Respecting my outward affairs, may inform that we have been favored with health for the most part, which is cause of thankfulness. I am favored with great plenty & the most part has been prosperous, yet some losses in creatures being sickly (one is dead). I wish to receive all with humility & gratitude the cares that appears needful to rest on me is great & desire the prayers of my Friends for me, that the divine preserver & director may be near, to me & my poor fatherless children, that we may be kept as under his holy notice (poor unworthy beings).
The children grow fast & are at a great loss for a good tutor, there being no school near.

I have wrote as it occurred whilst writing & may add that Anne Vennable lives with me. Thomas French is in a short time free & expects to go to Jersey see his relations & if so permitted, return & hire with me. He has behaved himself in a dutiful orderly way as far as I know & its my desire that he may be under the notice of Friends as a plant that requires care & advice; I have endeavored to do my duty by him as far as has been in my power, in a measure of that love that time nor distance don’t lessen

closer.salute: I, salute thee, thy wife & children with the rest of our near kindred, and remain thy tried sister,

postscript.label: P.S.
postscript.p: My sister Elizabeth has been much tried with things disagreeable, being under deep exercise of mind respecting what she believed was required of her, that her life & spirits have been reduced so to, that it has been very alarming to some of us lest she would be quite over set. She was here last night & appeared something better. I have wished a sense of her situation might react to them that could sympathize with her & Jonas who is under great discouragements.
